findings.summary: The 10 application files plus REPORT match the granted output list. The code I could inspect looks sound. Branded mock only, no network or credential imports anywhere in the worker module graph. The job/attempt/fence row is committed before the mock runs, and no transaction is held across the provider await. Authority is rechecked after the journal append, revisions are immutable successors with publish_authority=false, and there is no publish endpoint. The controller's npm test (129/129), build, 04-C cumulative checker, fixture probe and 8-scenario CUA on 0178ad6 back these claims. I cannot return PASS, though. This review session has no read access to the planning repository. I could not read the approved architecture v1.2 files, APPROVALS.md, PROJECT_CONTEXT, the pinned 00-B/00-C/05-G/04-C originals or setup-r1/r2. The card makes reading them mandatory and requires stating coverage, and a PASS would trigger the merge. The shipped REPORT and contract doc also still describe a pre-final verification state.

findings.title: Reviewer could not read mandatory authority, originals and setup reviews
findings.problem: The card requires the feature reviewer to read approved/engineering-v1 (README, ENGINEERING_DESIGN_V1, MODULE_GUIDE, REVIEW_NOTES) and approved/APPROVALS.md. It also requires the pinned originals (00-B CONTRACTS blob 1e85333, 00-C SCREEN_CONTRACT_MAP f1f3c8f, 05-G GENERATION_CONTRACT/TRIAL_RESULTS, 04-C ACCEPTANCE_NOTES) and setup-r1/setup-r2.json, read in full with coverage stated. Every read outside .agent-loop/application was denied by permissions in this session. Coverage actually achieved is limited to the app checkout: AGENTS.md, the full diff, lib/loop/fixture-adventure.mjs, the helpers in continuation-journal.mjs, queue-journal.mjs lines 230-289, and import scans of request-queue.mjs and environment.mjs. So I could not check conformance to ADR-E03/04/05/06 text, WM-05, the 00-B schema text (only its app-side fixture) or 00-C O03/SC08. I could not assess the carried setup minors, or confirm that setup review records were not rewritten. AGENTS.md says: identify the missing evidence rather than proceeding from memory. This is not a Codex code defect.
findings.fix_check: Re-run the feature review with read access to the planning repository root. The reviewer reads the listed originals and setup records and states their exact coverage.

findings.title: REPORT and contract doc still describe a pre-final verification state
findings.problem: REPORT says 'whole registered checks/CUA/feature review are not yet claimed' and 'Native feature reviews used 0 of 3'. docs/loop/GENERATION_LOCAL_SLICE.md (Verification state) says '18 checks passed; subsequent UI clarification is being rechecked'. Neither mentions the controller whole-check PASS or the CUA pass on 0178ad6. The card requires the REPORT to state actual complete coverage and gaps. Both records under-claim rather than over-claim, but they are inaccurate for a merged partial result.
findings.fix_check: REPORT and the doc's Verification state attribute the final check run and CUA to exact commit 0178ad6. They keep all earlier failures and state the feature-review round actually used.

findings.title: max_elapsed_ms limit is validated but never enforced
findings.problem: validateMockLimits requires max_elapsed_ms=10000, and the doc states a '10000ms elapsed bound'. Nothing in server/ reads limits.max_elapsed_ms, and max_attempts is enforced only implicitly by the attempts primary key. In practice the effective bound is the 5000ms lease, enforced lazily on read, plus the 1000ms provider timeout. The doc's stated bound is therefore not an implemented control.
findings.fix_check: Either enforce max_elapsed_ms (for example, completion after created_at+limit becomes uncertain), or state in the doc that lease/timeout are the enforced bounds and max_elapsed_ms is an unimplemented ceiling.

findings.title: A reconciled StartMock never runs and silently becomes uncertain
findings.problem: execute() is launched only from a fresh mutate whose StartMock is acknowledged at once. If the StartMock append is retryable_unacknowledged and later reconciled, or a replay is acknowledged, the job stays running with a lease but no worker. Once the lease expires, the next read marks it uncertain. This is fail-safe and does not auto-retry, but neither the UI copy nor the doc tells the founder that the mock never started.
findings.fix_check: The doc and UI text state that a recovered start becomes uncertain without running. Or a test asserts this exact path.

findings.title: Client body cap counts characters while server caps bytes
findings.problem: The client checks body.length>16384 in UTF-16 code units, while loop-auth caps request bytes at 16384. Non-ASCII edits can pass the client check and receive a 413, which the UI reports as a generic unknown confirmation.
findings.fix_check: The client measures the byte length (TextEncoder) against the same cap.

findings.title: Journal key-derivation label has a literal backslash, not NUL
findings.problem: 'generation-local-01\\0' produces a backslash followed by '0', whereas the service digest labels use a real NUL. The domain still differs, so this is not a security defect. It is inconsistent with the stated domain-separation format.
findings.fix_check: Use '\0' consistently, or document the label format. Note that changing it alters existing local journal keys.
